brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.requirement: Compact tidy storage for sewing supplies
requirements.evidence: 3-cell cluster (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full) joined with joint bolts, all cells fitted with bins for storage without extra fixings

requirements.requirement: Compartmentalized tray for small notions (threads, buttons, needles, pins)
requirements.evidence: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 provides 3 compartments; bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-div2 provides 2 compartments for sorted small items

requirements.requirement: Open bulk tray for larger items (fabric scraps, patterns, scissors)
requirements.evidence: bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full full-depth open bin in cell 1,0,0 for bulk storage

finish.summary: Built a compact 3-hex cluster for sewing supplies: two compartmented bins (2- and 3-division) for small notions sorted by type, plus one full-depth open bin for bulk items like fabric and tools. Cells are bolted together into a stable, movable tidy unit.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
